name: Signature Microblading
shortDescription: Hyper-realistic, hand-drawn hair strokes designed to mimic natural eyebrow hairs for fuller, seamless arches.
fullDescription: Our Signature Microblading utilizes ultra-fine medical grade nano-blades to implant hypoallergenic, vegan pigments into the upper dermis. Each stroke is customized to flow with your natural brow growth pattern, bone structure, and facial proportions using the golden ratio method.
benefits: Natural 3D hair-like stroke effect
Custom Golden Ratio brow mapping
Saves 20+ minutes of daily morning makeup
Waterproof and smudge-resistant
Ideal for normal to dry skin types
steps: Pigment Color Formulation & Skin Matching (15 mins)
Pigment Mask & Sterile Post-Care Seal (10 mins)

name: Ombré Powder Brows
shortDescription: Soft powdery makeup finish featuring lighter ombre bulb fronts fading into defined, velvety tails.
fullDescription: Ombré Powder Brows are achieved with an advanced digital micropigmentation machine creating hundreds of thousands of microscopic pigment dots. The result is a soft powdered makeup look that is gentle on all skin types including oily or mature skin.
benefits: Soft misty powdered finish
Superior retention for oily or large-pore skin
Less invasive with minimal skin trauma
Lasts up to 3 years before touch-up
Completely customizable density

name: Combination Hybrid Brows
shortDescription: The ultimate transformation combining hair strokes at the head with soft powder shading through the tail.
fullDescription: Combination brows give you the best of both worlds: delicate realistic hair strokes at the head of the brow for natural softness, combined with gentle machine powder shading through the body and tail for crisp definition and depth.
benefits: Combines realistic hair strokes + 3D depth
Great for clients with sparse or patchy brows
Tail stays crisp and defined throughout the day
Suitable for all skin types
Seamless blend with existing eyebrow hair
steps: Custom Brow Architecture & Golden Ratio (30 mins)
Pigment Formulation for Multi-Depth Effect (15 mins)
Pixel Shading Arch to Tail (60 mins)

name: Digital Nano Hairstrokes
shortDescription: High-precision single acupuncture needle hair strokes made with medical digital device. Zero skin slicing.
fullDescription: Digital Nano Brows represent the pinnacle of PMU technology. Using a microscopic 0.18mm acupuncture needle and high-precision motor, hair strokes are deposited as micro-dots rather than blade incisions, ensuring zero scarring risk and supreme retention across all skin types.
benefits: Non-cutting digital technique
Exceptional longevity on oily, mature or sensitive skin
Zero scar tissue formation
Fast healing with minimal scabbing
Crisp stroke retention after healing
steps: Pigment Selection with Organic Hybrid Pigments (15 mins)
Cold Compress & Cell Regenerating Serum (20 mins)

name: Velvet Lip Blush & Tint
shortDescription: Translucent mineral wash that restores natural borders, balances lip symmetry, and provides a healthy flush.
fullDescription: Lip Blush is a semi-permanent tattoo that deposits botanical mineral pigments into the lips, creating an effortless wash of color and enhancing natural lip symmetry. It defines the Cupid's bow and vermilion border without looking like harsh 90s lip liner.
benefits: Restores natural lip shape and pale borders
Creates the illusion of fuller, juicier lips without fillers
Corrects mild asymmetry and loss of vermilion border
Wake up with fresh, youthful tint everyday
Custom shade range from nude rose to berry peach
steps: Lip Contour Mapping & Symmetry Balance (25 mins)
Custom Color Swatching & Undertone Test (15 mins)
Soothing Hydrogel Mask & Arnica Seal (10 mins)

name: Dark Lip Color Neutralization
shortDescription: Specialized color corrective treatment neutralizing cool, dark, or hyper-pigmented tones before depositing target color.
fullDescription: Dark lip neutralization is a specialized multi-session technique formulated specifically for melanin-rich lips exhibiting cool blue, purple, or brown undertones. Using warm corrective orange and warm-peach pigments, we neutralize melanin undertones to achieve an even, radiant canvas.
benefits: Specifically engineered for melanin-rich lips
Cancels out cool blue/purple undertones safely
Even, bright and warm balanced lip tone
Prevents trauma-induced hyperpigmentation
Perfection across 2 to 3 tailored sessions
steps: Fitzpatrick Skin & Melanin Tone Assessment (20 mins)
Warm Orange Neutralizer Color Blending (15 mins)
Cold Barrier & Vitamin E Dressing (10 mins)

name: Old PMU Brow Color Correction
shortDescription: Color shift neutralization for outdated tattoo brows that have turned blue, red, pink, or gray over time.
fullDescription: If your previous permanent makeup has faded into an unwanted salmon-pink, slate-gray, or greenish-blue tint, our color correction protocol utilizes color theory and warm modifier pigments to restore a rich, flattering golden-brown tone without painful laser sessions.
benefits: Neutralizes unsightly orange, red, grey or blue hues
Re-establishes clean symmetry and modern shape
Saves client from painful laser removal if faded enough
Safe organic iron-oxide and hybrid formulas
Includes follow-up color assessment

fullDescription: Permanent makeup gradually fades as your skin regenerates and is exposed to UV light. An annual touch-up refreshes the color vibrancy, tightens the shape, and ensures your brows or lips look continuously fresh and polished year-round.
benefits: Maintains flawless pigment intensity
